profile.headline: Software Engineer at SpaceX
profile.summary:
I am a software engineer with experience in factory automation and high-performance phased arrays. I spent two years supporting the startup of a new robotic wing assembly system at Boeing. During that time I diagnosed and resolved machine issues on nights and weekends, implemented process improvements on the factory floor, developed a web application for product verification monitoring and prototyped a computer vision aid for tool inspections. 

I am interested in software engineering work in the field of autonomous systems. In December 2020 I completed a Master's in Electrical and Computer Engineering at UW with a focus on this topic.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
• Halved product regression test time and reduced defects by developing an automated hardware test framework (Python)
• Updated legacy embedded real-time flight software to meet export control requirements (C)
• Completed several bug fixes and maintainability improvements on in-house hardware test applications (C#)
• Gained familiarity with the design and architecture of high-performance airborne RF processing systems

positions.title: Materials and Process Engineer
positions.description:
• Responsible for day-to-day support and long-term improvement projects in a robotic manufacturing environment
• Prototyped algorithm and implemented GUI for computer vision system to detect drill bit damage (C++, OpenCV, MFC)
• Designed and fabricated adjustable stand for digital microscope to standardize drill bit inspections (SOLIDWORKS)
• Developed Web interface for product verification tracking using robot telemetry data (Cloud Foundry, Python, Django)
• Directed team of UW faculty and graduate students in data science project to identify and predict premature drill bit failures
• Operated industrial robots and collected and analyzed quality data during drill process development testing
• Worked night and weekend shifts supporting machine operators on factory floor during startup of 777X wing assembly line

positions.title: Committee Intern
positions.description: Intern for US House of Representatives Committee on Science, Space and Technology.

positions.title: Undergraduate Research Assistant
positions.description:
• Published Undergraduate Honors Thesis and three conference papers on automation of drilling fluid rheology testing
• Created MATLAB and Python code for Raspberry Pi to control and collect data from field-scale prototype

positions.title: Fixed Equipment Co-op
positions.description:
• Worked with vendor to design and accelerate manufacturing of $1.2M in safety-critical specialty heat exchangers
• Completed 15+ piping repair packages in compliance with company and industry design specifications
• Learned to effectively navigate complex engineering organization and excel under challenging workload
